name: 自定义命令

features.name: 内建 /init：调研工作区并生成或更新 AGENTS.md
features.nameEn: Built-in /init: study the workspace and create or update AGENTS.md

features.name: 命令资源创建、编辑与开关
features.nameEn: Command resource creation, editing and switches

features.name: 目录型 Markdown 命令发现与位置参数展开
features.nameEn: File-shaped Markdown commands with positional argument expansion
